create_Linearization_subclass: create a subclass of Linearization that implements _linearize_jacobian_impl and _linearize_hessian_impl for custom optimization
linearize_objective: call linearize on a Linearization instance to compute the Hessian of the objective with optional detaching
get_AtA_matrix: access the AtA property on a Linearization instance to get the A transpose A matrix as a tensor
get_AtB_vector: access the Atb property on a Linearization instance to get the A transpose b vector as a tensor
compute_diagonal_scaling: call diagonal_scaling on a Linearization instance to compute diag(A^T @ A) multiplied by a vector
